mapper.select: SELECT tp.*, t.name FROM team_points tp LEFT JOIN teams t ON tp.team_id = t.id ORDER BY tp.total_points DESC
SELECT tp.*, t.name FROM team_points tp LEFT JOIN teams t ON tp.team_id = t.id WHERE tp.team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_points SET points = #{points}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
UPDATE team_points SET today_points = #{todayPoints}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
UPDATE team_points SET total_points = #{totalPoints}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
UPDATE team_points SET ranking = #{ranking}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
